messages:
emma_pm: Morning team - kickoff thread for 'weighted-region routing' rollout. Goal: steer traffic to lower-cost model variants in EU/APAC while protecting customer SLAs. Need alignment on rollout pace, gating, and enterprise opt-ins.

raj_engineer: Proposed rings: canary 0.25% for 15m, mini 1% for 45m, broad 15% for 90m, ramp to 60% after 24h. Each ring runs metric gating.

kai_sre: Suggest we require a 3x sampling shadow stream so every routed request also hits baseline model for quality checks. Hard aborts: client-error spike > 0.4% OR tail latency (p99) increase > 50ms absolute and >30% relative.

sophia_research: For automated quality gating: use embedding-sim delta on a fixed probe set + lightweight hallucination classifier. Pause if embedding-sim mean drops by 1.8% or halluc classifier increases by 0.8pp. We'll also run a quick human review if a gate trips.

emma_pm: Ownership: Product owns the rollout schedule; Eng owns flag rollout API; SRE owns alert thresholds & runbook; Research owns metrics and probe data.

devex: Flag schema idea: routing.weighted.v1.region.{code}.bucket.{n}.policy = [baseline, variantA, variantB]. Include per-tenant sticky session id overrides and admin override endpoint.

raj_engineer: Implement cache-warming and staged prefetching to avoid cold-start latencies. Also add a global throttle to cap total percentage of traffic to variants across all regions to 70% to avoid simultaneous spikes.

kai_sre: Observability: per-region ring dashboards, diff charts for latency & quality (variant vs baseline), alert hooks to PagerDuty + Slack. We'll add a 'rollout pause' button in runbook that triggers immediate traffic reversion.

emma_pm: Rollout calendar draft: Week 1 - US & EU low-risk customers, Week 2 - wider EU & APAC subset, Week 3 - all regions. Block customers with active incident windows and invite enterprise opt-ins to pre-approve.

sophia_research: Need ~3k shadow-samples per region to get stable metrics. Will prioritize EU runs first.

devex: UI plan: add per-tenant 'route-preview' and temporary logs for SEs. Admin kill-switch to be visible in the Console and also available via api.

emma_pm: Decision list: 1) final ring sizes and durations, 2) exact gating numbers, 3) enterprise default opt-in behavior, 4) flag naming. Please ack with final numbers.

raj_engineer: Ack for eng: rings as proposed. Gate numbers: p99 latency cap +30% vs baseline, error-rate abort at 0.6%, warning at 0.25%.

kai_sre: SRE ack for runbook ownership. We'll set p99 latency absolute cap 200ms for text-gen endpoints, abort if exceeded. Also require a 1h quiet window after any abort before retrying.

sophia_research: Research ack. Will deliver probe set and initial dashboards by EOD Thursday.

devex: DevEx ack. Will scaffold admin UI and tenant controls. Need API schema from eng by tomorrow morning.

emma_pm: ship-bot: start canary ring 0.25 in eu-west-1 please.

ship-bot: action: routing/weighted/v1 canary roll initiated by emma_pm in eu-west-1 ring 0.25.

emma_pm: Thanks everyone. I'll post the finalized schedule and runbook link here once runbook is approved. :rocket:
